text:
sara: FYI — Sales intake from Acme Financial asking for Dedicated GPU pool sizing. They say ~200 concurrent sessions, bursty daytime traffic, target p95 latency <= 350ms, preferred model family = redwood-13b-quant or 7b-quant. They asked for a ballpark GPU quote + autoscale/burst policy. cc @matt @anil

matt: can you paste the sales form or raw numbers? need QPS and peak distribution, not just 'concurrent sessions'.

sara: copied from Sales intake form:
- customer: Acme Financial (fintech, EU)
- use case: real-time chat + transaction enrichment (sync, low-latency)
- sessions: 200 typical concurrent, 500 peak bursts (3x/day, 5-15m)
- sequence length: avg ~1000 tokens (prompt+response), peaks 2048
- latency target: p95 <= 350ms
- compliance: SOC2 + EU data residency
- ask: monthly cost estimate, recommended start config, lead time

anil: quick rough/back-of-envelope: if you interpret "200 concurrent generating simultaneously" as steady-state active generation -> tokens/s = 200 * 1000 = 200k tps. If optimized perf ~= 800 tokens/s per A100-80GB, naive GPUs = 200k / 800 ≈ 250 GPUs (not realistic). We need QPS (requests/sec) and average tokens per request. Sales is conflating idle sessions with active QPS.

kevin: agree — sessions != requests/sec. If sessions sit idle waiting for users, effective QPS is much lower. Also caching/prefix reuse and streaming change compute. Ask Sales for: requests per minute, avg tokens per request, active session fraction (how many sessions are 'typing' at once).

sara: @matt can you ask Sales to pull telemetry from their pilot (requests/min, avg request tokens, session idle fraction)? Also suggest we offer a PoC: start with a small dedicated pool + burst to hosted for peaks.

matt: will ask. In the meantime proposing a conservative product-level autoscale suggestion to include in the quote:
```
base_capacity: 5 x A100-80GB
scale_step: +5 GPUs per 60s
max_capacity: 50 GPUs
burst_policy: soft-failover to Hosted API for excess traffic (with rate-limited fallback)
provision_lead: 48-72h for dedicated nodes
```
Need legal sign-off for cross-tenant burst.

julia: for pricing, I'll draft a monthly reserved price per A100 + usage overage. Need tokens/day estimate to finalize.

ops-bot: reminder: provisioning window for Dedicated clusters is typically 48h; large clusters (20+ GPUs) may need longer lead time.

anil: If customer insists on 200 fully-active simultaneous sessions at 1000 tokens/session, recommend alternative strategies: shorter responses, model distillation (smaller model), aggressive batching, prefix/KV caching, or hybrid approach (dedicated baseline + hosted burst). Also propose a perf test plan: run synthetic traffic with their session mix and measure p95 and tokens/s per GPU.

sara: Decision from triage: move to "needs more info". Action items:
- @matt: collect QPS, requests/min, avg tokens/request, active session fraction from Sales + telemetry samples (due EOD Fri)
- @julia: draft pricing template and ballpark cost model (use placeholder tokens/day)
- @anil: propose PoC config (initial perf cluster + perf test harness), and a short runbook for fallback to Hosted
I updated backlog: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REQ-3245 (adding intake details).

matt: :thumbsup: will update Sales and push for telemetry. If they push for immediate quote we'll provide a high-level 'indicative' quote with clear caveats.

julia: :memo: I'll prepare the template and share sample numbers once we have tokens/day.

sara: Thanks all. Do not give a firm SLA or hard capacity commitment until PoC results. If Sales needs a faster path, propose a short paid PoC (2 weeks) to gather real numbers and validate latency.
